description: Transpower publishes point locations of high-voltage transmission structures, including poles, towers, gantries and termination points. Locations represent ground centre points. The source says updates occur as needed and cautions that Transpower does not own all structures in New Zealand’s electricity network. The schema includes location identifiers, structure types and status. The data describe mapped assets, not structural capacity, condition or a complete national distribution inventory. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing Transpower transmission-lines record.
